Property: Size Items.description: Component size modifier. Declare on parent container. Syntax: extra-small | small (default) | medium | large | extra-large

Property: Width Items.description: Component width modifier. Declare on parent container. Syntax: narrow | normal (default) | wide

Property: Shape Items.description: Component shape modifier. Declare on parent container. Syntax: round (default) | square

Property: Typeface Base.description: Base font family for typography system. Declare on html or :root. Syntax: "<string>#"

Property: Typeface Brand.description: Font family for display, headline, title large. Declare on html or :root. Syntax: "<string>#"

Property: Typeface Plain.description: Font family for title medium/small, body, label. Declare on html or :root. Syntax: "<string>#"

Property: Typeface Emphasized Brand.description: Font family for emphasized display, headline, title large. Declare on html or :root. Syntax: "<string>#"

Property: Typeface Emphasized Plain.description: Font family for emphasized title medium/small, body, label. Declare on html or :root. Syntax: "<string>#"

Property: Typeface Generic.description: Fallback generic font family appended to font lists. Declare on html or :root. Syntax: <custom-ident>

Property: Typeface Symbols.description: Font family for icon glyphs inside components. Declare on html or :root. Syntax: "<string>#"

Primary.description: High-emphasis fills, texts, and icons against surface

Primary container.description: Standout fill color against surface, for key components like FAB

On primary container.description: Text and icons against primary container

Secondary.description: Less prominent fills, text, and icons against surface

Secondary container.description: Less prominent fill color against surface, for recessive components like tonal buttons

On secondary container.description: Text and icons against secondary container

Tertiary.description: Complementary fills, text, and icons against surface

Tertiary container.description: Complementary container color against surface, for components like input fields

On tertiary container.description: Text and icons against tertiary container

Error.description: Attention-grabbing color against surface for fills, icons, and text, indicating urgency

On error container.description: Text and icons against error container

On background.description: Main body text against the background canvas (equivalent to --sys-color-on-surface )

On surface.description: Text and icons against any surface or surface container color

Surface variant.description: Decorative surface alternative to standard surface; lower-emphasis surface variant

On surface variant.description: Lower-emphasis color for text and icons against any surface or surface container color

Surface bright.description: Brightest surface color in light and dark modes

Surface dim.description: Dimmest surface color in light and dark modes

Primary fixed.description: Fill color used against surface; maintains the same tone in light and dark modes

On primary fixed.description: Text and icons which sit on top of the primary fixed color

Primary fixed dim.description: Stronger, more emphasized tone relative to primary fixed; same tone in light and dark modes

On primary fixed variant.description: Text and icons needing lower emphasis against the primary fixed color

Secondary fixed.description: Fill color used against surface; maintains the same tone in light and dark modes

On secondary fixed.description: Text and icons which sit on top of the secondary fixed color

Secondary fixed dim.description: Stronger, more emphasized tone relative to secondary fixed; same tone in light and dark modes

On secondary fixed variant.description: Text and icons needing lower emphasis against the secondary fixed color

Tertiary fixed.description: Fill color used against surface; maintains the same tone in light and dark modes

On tertiary fixed.description: Text and icons which sit on top of the tertiary fixed color

Tertiary fixed dim.description: Stronger, more emphasized tone relative to tertiary fixed; same tone in light and dark modes

On tertiary fixed variant.description: Text and icons needing lower emphasis against the tertiary fixed color

Outline.description: Important boundaries, such as a text field outline

Outline variant.description: Decorative elements, such as dividers, and when other elements provide 4.5:1 contrast

Shadow.description: Color used for elevation drop shadows

Scrim.description: Overlay color for backdrop scrims behind modals and sheets

Surface tint.description: Legacy surface tint color, retained for compatibility. Surface tint is deprecated in Material 3.

Inverse surface.description: Background fills for elements which contrast against surface

Inverse on surface.description: Text and icons against inverse surface

Inverse primary.description: Actionable elements, such as text buttons, against inverse surface

Level0.description: none. Use with box-shadow. Filled, tonal, and outlined buttons; button groups; filled and outlined cards.

Level1.description: Use with box-shadow. Elevated buttons, cards, and chips; modal bottom sheets, navigation drawers, and side sheets.

Level2.description: Use with box-shadow. Scrolled app bars, menus, navigation bars, rich tooltips, and toolbars.

Level3.description: Use with box-shadow. FABs, extended FABs, modal dialogs, date pickers, time pickers, and search.

Level4.description: Use with box-shadow. Not assigned as a resting level. Reserved for interaction states.

Level5.description: Use with box-shadow. Not assigned as a resting level. Reserved for interaction states.

Spring fast spatial.description: Use as the transition or animation timing function. Small components, such as switches and buttons.

Spring fast spatial duration.description: 350ms. Use as the transition or animation duration with --sys-motion-spring-fast-spatial.

Spring default spatial.description: Use as the transition or animation timing function. Animations that partially cover the screen, such as a bottom sheet or expanded navigation rail.

Spring default spatial duration.description: 500ms. Use as the transition or animation duration with --sys-motion-spring-default-spatial.

Spring slow spatial.description: Use as the transition or animation timing function. Full-screen animations.

Spring slow spatial duration.description: 650ms. Use as the transition or animation duration with --sys-motion-spring-slow-spatial.

Spring fast effects.description: Use as the transition or animation timing function. Color change of the switch handle.

Spring fast effects duration.description: 150ms. Use as the transition or animation duration with --sys-motion-spring-fast-effects.

Spring default effects.description: Use as the transition or animation timing function. Opacity of content within a navigation rail.

Spring default effects duration.description: 200ms. Use as the transition or animation duration with --sys-motion-spring-default-effects.

Spring slow effects.description: Use as the transition or animation timing function. Full-screen content refresh.

Spring slow effects duration.description: 300ms. Use as the transition or animation duration with --sys-motion-spring-slow-effects.

Focus ring motion spring.description: Animates the focus ring beyond its resting width, then settles back. Use as the transition or animation timing function with --focus-ring-motion-duration.

Focus ring motion duration.description: 350ms. Use as the transition or animation duration with --focus-ring-motion-spring.

Media Query: Motion No Preference.description: prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference. User has made no preference known regarding reducing motion.

Media Query: Motion Reduce.description: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. User has requested the system minimize non-essential motion.

Media Query: Transparency No Preference.description: prefers-reduced-transparency: no-preference. User has made no preference regarding reduced transparency.

Media Query: Transparency Reduce.description: prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce. User has requested the system minimize transparent layer effects.

Media Query: Data No Preference.description: prefers-reduced-data: no-preference. User has made no preference regarding reduced data.

Media Query: Data Reduce.description: prefers-reduced-data: reduce. User has expressed preference for lightweight alternate content.

Media Query: Scheme Dark.description: prefers-color-scheme: dark. User has requested a dark mode.

Media Query: Scheme Light.description: prefers-color-scheme: light. User has requested a light mode.

Media Query: Contrast More.description: prefers-contrast: more. User has requested a higher contrast.

Media Query: Contrast Less.description: prefers-contrast: less. User has requested a lower contrast.

Media Query: Inverted Colors.description: inverted-colors: inverted. Colors are inverted by the OS.

Media Query: Forced Colors Active.description: forced-colors: active. User has enabled forced colors mode (e.g. Windows High Contrast).

Media Query: Landscape.description: orientation: landscape. Viewport is in landscape orientation.

Media Query: HDR Display.description: dynamic-range: high. Device supports high dynamic range (HDR) or P3 wide color gamut.

Media Query: Touch Interface.description: pointer: coarse. Primary input is a touch screen (phones, tablets).

Media Query: Stylus on Non-Hover.description: pointer: fine and hover: none. Primary input is a stylus on a screen without hover.

Media Query: Hover with Coarse Pointer.description: pointer: coarse and hover: hover. Primary input has hover but is coarse.

Media Query: Mouse / Desktop.description: pointer: fine and hover: hover. Primary input is a mouse or trackpad.

Supports: animation-timeline.description: @supports block checking for animation-timeline CSS support.

Supports Not: animation-timeline.description: @supports block checking for missing animation-timeline CSS support.

CSS Custom Property Registration.description: Register a typed CSS custom property. Choose an initial value that matches the selected syntax; the default is a length.
